description: The configuration surface of the mail-mailbox chart. GENERATED from values.yaml by `./build.sh Charts` and diffed in CI — docs/plan/03 § charts/. Edit values.yaml, never this file. Members carrying `x-cybercloud-api: false` are chart or platform plumbing and are not part of the resource body.

aliases.description: Other local parts of the same domain that deliver here. An alias another mailbox already answers for is refused by name.

forwardTo.description: Addresses every message is also sent on to. Forwarding leaves the domain, so it is held with the rest of the domain's outbound mail until its DNS records verify.

keepCopy.description: With forwardTo set, whether this mailbox keeps a copy as well. Without forwardTo it has no effect.

localPart.description: The part of the address before the @, for example alice. The domain supplies the rest. Lower case letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores.

nameOverride.description: Replace the generated object-name stem. Empty means derive it from the release name.
nameOverride.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Helm plumbing. Nothing about it belongs in a resource body.

passwordRef.description: A vault handle — path#field, optionally @version — whose value is the password this mailbox signs in to IMAP and submission with. Resolved and hashed when the mailbox is applied; the value never enters this body. The path must be under your tenant's vault prefix, tenants/<tenantId>/. Empty means the mailbox receives mail and nobody can sign in to it.

platform.description: Resource identity injected by the reconciler. Not a tenant-facing setting.

apiVersion.description: The api-version the resource was last written at. Not rendered, for the labels' reason.
apiVersion.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

domainSecret.description: The domain's mailbox Secret — MailDomains.UsersSecretName of the parent read off the ADDRESS.
domainSecret.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

mailDomain.description: The mail domain, read off that Secret's cybercloud.io/mail-domain annotation — a mailbox's address carries only the domain resource's name.
mailDomain.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceId.description: Resource GUID. Keys the three per-fragment annotations on the domain's Secret, and is the value of every `.claim` key this mailbox writes.
resourceId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

resourceType.description: Fully qualified resource type. Not rendered as a label; recorded here so the surface says what it is the surface of.
resourceType.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

tenantId.description: Tenant GUID. ⚠ CHECKED rather than rendered: a co-writer writes no labels, and the co-owned apply refuses an object whose cybercloud.io/tenant-id is not this one.
tenantId.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

platform.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Written by the reconciler from the resource's own identity. A tenant cannot set it, so it is not part of the resource body.

quota.description: The most this mailbox may store, in Kubernetes quantity form, for example 5Gi. Empty means the domain's storage.mailboxQuota.
